title: Two-Sample Inference for Gaussian-Smoothed Wasserstein Costs with Finite Moments
summary: Gaussian smoothing has emerged as an effective technique for reducing the sample complexity of optimal transport. In this paper, we study the two-sample plug-in estimator of the Gaussian-smoothed Wasserstein cost \(T_p^{(σ)}(μ,ν)=W_p(μ*γ_σ,ν*γ_σ)^p\) on \(\R^d\). For fixed smoothing and finite polynomial moments \(M_{q_μ}(μ) p\), we establish upper bounds in probability of order \(ρ_{q_μ,p,d}(m)+ρ_{q_ν,p,d}(n)\).
